main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Follow the ONE ❤️ to ignite the divine spark ✝️.
header_desc: You are asleep 🧠 your brain dwells in an illusion ┻: What our civilization calls Christ is a birth condition unrelated to religion that links human consciousness to the cosmos. Primordial consciousness reveals that our left hemisphere —the psyche— is tied to the temporal and material, while the right —the pneuma— opens up to the timeless and divine, and thus invites us to invert the map ✝️ and awaken ❤️
left_title: The Return of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth to the Kingdom of Light
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written almost two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest puzzles in modern physics: quantum gravity, demonstrating that human existence transcends both matter and space-time. In this framework, consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ ❤️ and the material |EGO⟩ 🧠. This grants us a free will of perception that can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE|EGO⟩. In general relativity, matter tells space-time how to curve, and space-time tells matter how to move. Similarly, the ego wields its own gravity: its density warps your inner fabric and weaves the temporal and material illusion of the psyche 🧠. Thus, only through the wisdom of Sophia is it possible to understand that the phrase “the Father and I are one” is a call to dissolve the “false self” to return to the Kingdom of pure light where the Invisible Father dwells: the timeless and divine reality of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is inside you and outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3). Pistis Sophia represents the right hemisphere, while the demiurge Yaldabaoth embodies the left, thus revealing the fundamental duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The flight of science and spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why the laws of Newton and Maxwell do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's break with simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The Faggin--Segarra conceptual assembly: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free from time and space.
cap4_desc: The finding of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as an imprisonment of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas but to liberate the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, a self-centered god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Compared eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The Orwellian doublethink mechanism (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, against Jesus' revolutionary message that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The end, the great paradox boils down to this: in the vastness of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— is where the phrase of Jesus resonates most strongly: “The Father and I are one.” Was there a hidden message about the deep connection between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a fiery beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity</q>
